admin.title: Payments for {{service}}
admin.readOnly: Only managers can change payment settings.

modes.hold: Hold the amount on their card

modeHint.deposit: The guest pays the amount when they book. You can refund it from the console.
modeHint.hold: The amount is reserved on the guest's card and released when they show up. You can charge it if they do not.

admin.cutoffHint: Cancelling at least this many hours ahead releases the hold. Later than that, you may charge the fee.

invalid.amount: Enter an amount above zero, such as 15 or 15.50.
invalid.cutoff: Enter a whole number of hours from 0 to 720.

errors.permission_denied: Only managers can change payment settings.
errors.payments_not_connected: Connect and enable a card processor under Integrations before asking guests to pay.

console.title: Payments

charge.title: Charge {{amount}}?
charge.description: This charges the guest's card {{amount}} for not showing up. It cannot be undone, only refunded.

refund.title: Refund this payment?
refund.description: Up to {{amount}} can be refunded. A refund cannot be undone.

console.queued: Queued. The status updates when the payment provider confirms.
console.error: That did not go through. Check the status and try again.

request.invalid: Enter an amount above zero, such as 15 or 15.50.
request.error: That did not go through. Check the visit and try again. If the guest already opened the request, refund it instead.
request.sent: Requested. The guest sees it on their phone.

payCode.title: Scan to pay {{amount}}
payCode.description: The guest scans this with their own phone. It opens the card form for this payment only.
payCode.label: QR code to pay {{amount}}
payCode.expires: Valid for 10 minutes. Showing it again replaces this code.
payCode.error: Could not make a code. Check that the payment is still unpaid and try again.
